name: BambooHR
description: BambooHR is a human-resources platform for company, employee, payroll, benefits, recruiting, time, and workforce operations.
agentUseSummary: Connect one exact BambooHR Company Domain and selected Job Location through Relay's Marketplace OAuth Application with exactly field, meta, and offline_access. Agents can list a bounded first page of Job Locations, inspect the selected Location with address details removed, and list bounded Country Options. Relay excludes every employee record, report, dataset, company contact, address detail, write, raw API, broader scope, and pagination.

blocked.label: Read employee data
blocked.description: Employees, directories, photos, contacts, demographics, dependents, compensation, benefits, leave, payroll, recruiting, time, and files are outside V1.

blocked.label: Read sensitive BambooHR data
blocked.description: Reports, datasets, field catalogs, custom fields, users, address details, company profile/contact data, credentials, and security data are outside V1.

blocked.label: Change BambooHR
blocked.description: Location, employee, company, payroll, recruiting, time, file, and every other mutation are outside V1.

blocked.label: Use raw BambooHR API
blocked.description: API keys, arbitrary hosts, paths, queries, expands, filters, page numbers, pagination, raw responses, and broader OAuth scopes are outside V1.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The three selected read-only tools run without per-action approval while exact company and Location binding, scope checks, bounds, redaction, and audit remain enforced.
